descriptions: THE PROGRAM EXECUTIVE OFFICE-COMMAND, CONTROL, COMMUNICATIONS TACTICAL (PEO-C3T) AND U.S. ARMY HAD A REQUIREMENT FOR A RELIABLE AND SECURE RADIO FREQUENCY (RF) COMMUNICATIONS CAPABILITY WHICH CAN BE HOISTED ON A COMMAND, CONTROL, COMMUNICATIONS, COMPUTERS, INTELLIGENCE, SURVEILLANCE AND RECONNAISSANCE (C4ISR) ELECTRONIC WARFARE (EW) MODULAR OPEN SUITE OF STANDARDS (CMOSS) CHASSIS AND IS INTEROPERABLE WITH OTHER C4ISR AND ELECTRONIC WARFARE (EW) SYSTEMS. THIS PROCUREMENT IS AUTHORIZED UNDER THE DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE (DOD) RAPID INNOVATION FUND (RIF). THE GOAL OF THE RIF IS TO FACILITATE THE RAPID INSERTION OF INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES INTO MILITARY SYSTEMS OR PROGRAMS THAT MEET CRITICAL NATIONAL SECURITY NEEDS. THE BAA IS FOR THE VALIDATION AND TRANSITION OF INNOVATIVE TECHNOLOGIES DEVELOPED PREDOMINANTLY BY SMALL BUSINESSES, INCLUDING THOSE RESULTING FROM THE SMALL BUSINESS INNOVATION RESEARCH (SBIR) PROGRAM AND DOD REIMBURSED INDEPENDENT RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT (IR&D). THE PROCUREMENT WAS SYNOPSIZED THROUGH THE FEDERAL BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES (FBO) WEBSITE BY THE WASHINGTON HEADQUARTERS SERVICES, ACQUISITION DIRECTORATE UNDER THE FY2017 RAPID INNOVATION FUND, BROAD AGENCY ANNOUNCEMENT NUMBER HQ0034-17-BAA-RIF-0001 ON MARCH 17, 2017. THE BAA WAS AWARDED TO POC ON 12 JULY 2018. FOR THIS EFFORT, POC WILL DESIGN, DEVELOP, TEST, AND DEMONSTRATE A MODULAR ASSURED COMMUNICATIONS AND ELECTRONIC WARFARE (MACE) PROTOTYPE (MACE) SYSTEM PROVIDING SECURE COMMUNICATIONS AND RADIO FREQUENCY (RF) MITIGATION OF OUT-OF-BAND SIGNALS. MACE WILL BE (1) INSTALLED AND OPERATE INSIDE A CMOSS CHASSIS; (2) WILL BE BUILT TO BE CAPABLE OF PASSING STANDARD MILITARY CERTIFICATIONS (SHOCK, VIBE, INFORMATION ASSURANCE (IA), ENVIRONMENTAL, ETC.); AND (3) WILL BE CAPABLE TO DEMONSTRATE IN A FIELD EVENT FOR PROGRAM MANAGEMENT-TACTICAL RADIOS (PM-TR).  1. TO REMOVE FEDERAL ACQUISITION REGULATION (FAR) CLAUSES 52.246-8 INSPECTION OF RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT- COST REIMBURSEMENT (MAY 2001)--ALTERNATE I (APRIL 1984) AND ADD FAR CLAUSE 52.246-3 INSPECTION OF SUPPLIES- COST REIMBURSEMENT AND FAR CLAUSE 52.246-5 INSPECTION OF SERVICES- COST REIMBURSEMENT. 2. REPLACE IN SECTION J, ATTACHMENT 0002, PERFORMANCE WORK STATEMENT (PWS) DATED 29 JUNE 2018 WITH THE REVISED VERSION DATED 12 SEPTEMBER 2018. ON 30 AUGUST 2018, A SYSTEMS REQUIREMENTS REVIEW (SRR) MEETING WAS HELD BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT AND POC TO DISCUSS THE HARDWARE BEING DEVELOPED AND THE SOFTWARE COMPATIBILITY REQUIRED TO MEET THE STANDARDS NEEDED FOR THE BENEFIT OF THE WARFIGHTER. AS A RESULT OF THE DISCUSSIONS, BOTH PARTIES AGREED IN THE PWS TO REMOVE ALL REFERENCES TO AN/PRC-159 TACTICAL RADIO AND UPDATE WITH A HARDWARE NEUTRAL LANGUAGE.

ADMIN MOD TO UPDATE CDRL DATE AND DD254 CAGE CODE. POC WILL DESIGN, DEVELOP, TEST, AND DEMONSTRATE A MACE SYSTEM PROVIDING SECURE COMMUNICATIONS AND RF MITIGATION OF OUT-OF-BAND SIGNALS. MACE WILL BE INSTALLED AND OPERATE INSIDE A CMOSS CHASSIS.

THE PURPOSE OF THIS ADMINISTRATIVE MODIFICATION IS TO CHANGE THE LINE OF ACCOUNTING.  THE DESCRIPTION OF CONTRACT REQUIREMENT IS FOR THE CONTRACTOR TO DESIGN, DEVELOP, TEST AND DEMONSTRATE A MACE PROTOTYPE SYSTEM INSIDE A CMOSS CHASSIS.
